color.description: An RGB colour triple, 0-255 per channel.

highlight.description: VA-5: one continuous tile-highlight effect. Drawn every frame while its tile is highlighted, as a world-space depth-sorted diamond (game/ui/widgets.py submit_tile_diamond / _fill), or as the bound sprite_slot's sheet when one has art.

border_width.description: Outline thickness in px (the LINE width for wall_edge).

fill_alpha.description: Interior fill alpha, 0-255; 0 draws an outline only (every shipped highlight).

ramp.description: A 3-stop age-fraction colour ramp: stop_0 (age 0) -> stop_1 -> stop_2 (age ~life).

trigger_row.description: ESV-5: one event's sprite/procedural binding. Resolution order at every dispatch site: a non-empty sprite_slot whose slot has imported art spawns a one-shot PlayOnceVfx sprite (engine.vfx.spawn_play_once); otherwise the named procedural kind runs; procedural "" (or the event's row absent from the table entirely) is a silent no-op (E-37) - never a raise.

draw_in_front.description: VfxAuthoringPLAN VA-2/D5: true draws this effect IN FRONT of a building or enemy sharing its tile, false behind it. It is a same-tile TIE-BREAK, not a layer switch - the effect still depth-sorts by its own world position against everything else, so an effect on a near tile keeps drawing over a building on a far one. Buildings and enemies share the `entities` layer and sort by iso depth, which is why this is ONE bool and not a separate one per kind: no sort order can put an effect in front of one and behind the other. Ships true on every row, reproducing the always-on-top behaviour every procedural effect had before (D10).

procedural.description: The procedural VFX kind to run when sprite_slot is empty or has no imported art yet, or "" for a silent no-op. spark_place/spark_level/spark_tier all resolve through the same emit_burst call, keyed by the caller's kind argument - the three names exist so each of the three building-vfx events can be independently retuned/disabled without collapsing to one shared string. "crater" names the mortar shell's OWN continuous fade mark (game/enemies/combat.py's Crater/CraterFade), which always spawns unconditionally regardless of this table - naming it here is documentation, not a second spawn. "highlight" (VA-5) means "draw this event's own procedural.highlights entry" - the seven continuous tile highlights all name it, and each is tuned by its OWN block, so unlike the spark_* trio they need no separate kind each.

sprite_slot.description: The vfx_* slot key to play as a one-shot sprite when it has imported art, or "" to always use the procedural fallback. A bound slot with no art imported yet also falls through to the procedural fallback (E-37) - this is what keeps a fresh checkout byte-identical to today.

variant_select.description: VfxAuthoringPLAN VA-2: how to choose among sprite_slot's interchangeable VARIANTS (the <stem>_v<k> slots sharing its leaf group in slots.json) each time this event fires. A slot with no variants resolves to itself under every mode, so this block is inert until a designer adds one. Procedural fallbacks are NOT varied (D3) - they have one param block each.

misc_key.description: For mode "misc" only: the name of a game-side value provider (game/vfx_misc.py's register()/resolve()). Code registers a function per key returning an int; an unregistered key - including the "" this ships with - resolves to variant 0 and never raises, so a key can be authored before the code that feeds it exists. Ignored by the other two modes.

mode.description: "random" picks uniformly per spawn through the caller's injected rng (the game/enemies/enemy.py variant_slot shape - never the stdlib random module, so seeded-parity tests stay possible). "level" indexes by the SOURCE's level, clamped to the variant count: a building's 0-indexed tier, an enemy's era. Five of the ten events carry only a world point and no source object, so "level" resolves to variant 0 there (D4) - deliberate, not a bug. "misc" indexes by misc_key's registered provider, clamped the same way.

description: Procedural VFX balancing domain (D-10): particle/gold/slash/splatter cosmetic tunables ported from game/ui/effects.py (ESV-3a), plus scene-object/continuous cosmetic tunables (beam/crater/lightning/announce, ESV-3b), plus a sibling triggers object (ESV-5) binding each cosmetic EVENT to an optional sprite one-shot + a procedural fallback. ESV-3a bounds: seconds 0-60, px/s velocities and px/s^2 gravity +-1000, sizes/radii 0-256 px, alpha 0-255, fractions/chances 0-1, line counts 0-100. ESV-3b bounds (data/CLAUDE.md house policy): alphas 0-255, seconds 0-60, pixels +-4096, counts 0-10000.

procedural.description: Every procedural cosmetic VFX tunable ESV-3a/ESV-3b port out of game/ui/effects.py module constants (and, for the two scene-object fade lifetimes, game/enemies/combat.py + game/core/lightning.py). ESV-5 added a sibling triggers object at the top level (see $defs/trigger_row).

announce.description: The boss-round announcement banner (submit_announce): colour + alpha ceiling only. The two copy strings stay game-side (screen-skinning territory) and the fade-in/hold/fade-out timings stay in ui.json FX.boss_announce.

max_alpha.description: Alpha at full opacity (k=1.0), scaled by the fade-in/hold/fade-out curve.

beam.description: The Sun Scorcher's continuous beam line (submit_beams): a 3-tier colour ramp indexed (clamped) by the defender's tier, a base width that thickens by +1 px per tier, and how many tile-heights above the origin the line starts.

origin_lift_tiles.description: How many tile-heights above the defender's centre the beam line starts (multiplies tile_h * zoom).

width_base.description: Base line width in px before the +1-per-tier bonus.

crater.description: A mortar shell's fading world-space scorch mark (submit_craters + CraterFade on the Crater GameObject). life is the fade lifetime in seconds; nothing but this cosmetic despawn clock reads it (D4 - not simulation timing).

alpha.description: Fill alpha at spawn (frac=1.0), scaling linearly to 0 as the crater fades.

life.description: Fade lifetime in seconds (cosmetic despawn clock only).

segments.description: Mortar scorch polygon-ring segment count (same world-unit N-gon helper the lightning blast marker uses; a world-space ring projects to the iso 2:1 ground ellipse).

death_burst.description: Building-death shard burst (watch_buildings): each shard picks ONE colour from colors, held for its whole life, and an independent w/h size drawn from a range.

gravity.description: Downward acceleration in px/s^2 (base-zoom screen pixels).

size_h_max.description: Maximum shard rect height in base-zoom px.

size_h_min.description: Minimum shard rect height in base-zoom px.

size_w_max.description: Maximum shard rect width in base-zoom px.

size_w_min.description: Minimum shard rect width in base-zoom px.

vx_max.description: Maximum horizontal launch velocity in px/s.

vx_min.description: Minimum horizontal launch velocity in px/s.

vy_max.description: Maximum vertical launch velocity in px/s (negative is up).

vy_min.description: Minimum vertical launch velocity in px/s (negative is up).

drummer_aura.description: The Drummer enemy's (NE-3) buff-range telegraph ring (submit_drummer_auras): a pulsing world-space ring drawn around a live Drummer, sized to its own support_range balancing value (EnemyTypes.Drummer.support_range) - not this block. alpha_min/alpha_max bound a smooth sine breathe over pulse_period_s seconds; segments is the ring's polygon-ring vertex count (the same world-unit N-gon helper the mortar crater and lightning marker use).

alpha_max.description: Ring fill alpha at the brightest point of the pulse.

alpha_min.description: Ring fill alpha at the dimmest point of the pulse.

pulse_period_s.description: Seconds for one full dim-to-bright-to-dim pulse cycle.

segments.description: Polygon-ring vertex count (the same world-unit N-gon helper the mortar scorch and lightning marker use; a world-space ring projects to the iso 2:1 ground ellipse).

floaters.description: Income/XP/painter/boost floater colours + lifetimes (text layout itself stays HUD chrome, owned by game/ui/effects.py, not this schema).

income_life.description: Payout-phase floater lifetime in seconds — the boost/economy(+painter's own message shares painter_life)/upkeep beats spawned by FloaterManager.begin_payout. Independent of core.PhaseLoop.income_phase_duration (the payout phase's own hold time), so the two can be tuned separately.

painter_life.description: Painter message floater lifetime in seconds.

gold_highlight.description: Gold tile highlight on a just-built / tier-advanced tile: fade in, hold, fade out. The fade-out duration is DERIVED as life - fade_in - hold (not a stored key) so the three can't drift out of sum.

life.description: Total highlight lifetime in seconds (fade_in + hold + derived fade_out).

highlights.description: VA-5: the seven tile highlights the panel and the host draw. Their colours USED to be data/ui/palette.json's highlight / highlight2 / range_highlight plus two bare code constants; those three palette keys are DELETED, so each value has exactly one home (G-7).

lightning.description: A lightning strike's jagged bolt + impact flash + ground marker (submit_lightning). bolt_life/marker_life are the fade lifetimes carried on LightningFXFade; nothing but the cosmetic despawn clocks read them (D4 - not simulation timing, unlike LightningStrike's damage/radius/cooldown in core.json).

bolt_jitter_px.description: Per-segment horizontal jitter magnitude in px, re-rolled every submitted frame (uniform(-jitter, +jitter)).

bolt_life.description: Bolt fade lifetime in seconds (cosmetic despawn clock only).

bolt_segments.description: Polyline segment count. A 1-segment bolt has no jitter point and degenerates to a straight line, so the minimum is 2.

flash_alpha.description: Impact flash alpha at bolt=1.0 (fresh strike), scaling with the bolt fraction.

flash_radius_px.description: Impact flash radius in screen px at zoom 1, converted to world units by /(tile_w/2) like splatter.radius_px.

marker_fill_alpha.description: Ground marker fill alpha at frac=1.0 (fresh strike), scaling linearly to 0 as it fades.

marker_life.description: Ground marker fade lifetime in seconds (cosmetic despawn clock only).

marker_outline_width.description: Ground marker outline width in px.

marker_segments.description: Ground blast-marker polygon-ring segment count (the same world-unit N-gon helper the crater scorch and the impact-flash octagon use; a world-space ring projects to the iso 2:1 ground ellipse).

muzzle.description: Ranged-attack muzzle spray (watch_enemies): std/strong variants share one ramp, velocity range, gravity and size; each particle independently rolls smoke_chance for a 1-tuple smoke_color ramp instead of the 3-stop ramp.

gravity.description: Downward acceleration in px/s^2 (base-zoom screen pixels).

life.description: Standard variant particle lifetime in seconds.

life_strong.description: Siege (strong) variant particle lifetime in seconds.

size_h.description: Particle rect height in base-zoom px.

size_w.description: Particle rect width in base-zoom px.

smoke_chance.description: Probability [0,1] a given particle is smoke instead of the ramp colour.

vx_max.description: Maximum horizontal launch velocity in px/s.

vx_min.description: Minimum horizontal launch velocity in px/s.

vy_max.description: Maximum vertical launch velocity in px/s (negative is up).

vy_min.description: Minimum vertical launch velocity in px/s (negative is up).

projectile.description: Fallback dot appearance for an in-flight shot with no imported sprite on vfx_projectile/vfx_shell (submit_projectiles): a coloured HudRect, lifted off the ground plane by a fraction of tile_h. Shell (mortar) and stone (every other defender) get independent colours/sizes. The max(2, size*zoom) low-zoom floor is a degeneracy guard, not a tunable, and stays inline in game/ui/effects.py.

lift_frac.description: Screen-space lift off the ground plane as a fraction of tile_h * zoom.

shell_size.description: Shell (mortar) dot diameter in base-zoom px, before the low-zoom floor.

stone_size.description: Stone (default) dot diameter in base-zoom px, before the low-zoom floor.

slash.description: Melee slash (watch_enemies): 2-3 diagonal lines over the attacker; size_large swaps in for a boss-scale attacker.

ox_max.description: Maximum per-line horizontal centre offset in base-zoom px.

ox_min.description: Minimum per-line horizontal centre offset in base-zoom px.

oy_max.description: Maximum per-line vertical centre offset in base-zoom px.

oy_min.description: Minimum per-line vertical centre offset in base-zoom px.

size.description: Line half-length in base-zoom px (standard attacker).

size_large.description: Line half-length in base-zoom px (boss-scale attacker).

spark.description: Placement/upgrade spark burst (spawn_building_vfx): one preset per caller-supplied kind (place/level1/level2/tier), sharing one velocity range, gravity, ramp and particle size.

gravity.description: Downward acceleration in px/s^2 (base-zoom screen pixels).

presets.description: Per-kind (life, count) pairs. Keys are game vocabulary, opaque to the engine.

size_h.description: Particle rect height in base-zoom px.

size_w.description: Particle rect width in base-zoom px.

vx_max.description: Maximum horizontal launch velocity in px/s.

vx_min.description: Minimum horizontal launch velocity in px/s.

vy_max.description: Maximum vertical launch velocity in px/s (negative is up).

vy_min.description: Minimum vertical launch velocity in px/s (negative is up).

splatter.description: Ground blood mark on an enemy death: a small alpha-filled polygon approximating a circle, projected to the 2:1 iso ground plane.

jitter.description: Jitter offset as a fraction of radius_px, used to blob the circle approximation.

radius_px.description: Screen-pixel radius at zoom 1, converted to world units by /(tile_w/2).

tutorial_highlight_pulse.description: The tile-buying tutorial topic's stronger pulse/glow overlay on TOP of procedural.highlights.tutorial_highlight's base colour/border_width (widgets.tutorial_pulse_style): border alpha AND width both breathe on a smooth sine cycle over pulse_period_s seconds, composed onto that base colour rather than duplicating it. Applies to every tutorial highlight in the game (tile diamonds via submit_highlight's pulse_color/pulse_width override, and the card/button UI-box rings via submit_ui_box_highlight) -- never the other six procedural.highlights entries, and never the close-panel-hint text banner (submit_tutorial_banner).

alpha_max.description: Border alpha at the brightest point of the pulse.

alpha_min.description: Border alpha at the dimmest point of the pulse.

pulse_period_s.description: Seconds for one full dim-to-bright-to-dim (and thin-to-thick-to-thin) pulse cycle.

width_max.description: Border width in pixels at the thickest point of the pulse.

width_min.description: Border width in pixels at the thinnest point of the pulse.

triggers.description: ESV-5: per-event sprite-slot / procedural-fallback binding, a sibling of procedural. Every key names a cosmetic EVENT (never a JSON-key vocabulary the engine sees); game/ui/effects.py's _triggers_from_balance is the ONE place these key names are read. VfxAuthoringPLAN VA-4: a non-base building revived by the payday building_revive slot (game/core/payday.py step 9). Fires once per building that was actually DEAD and came back - not for the full-heal every living building also gets in that slot - at its tile, drained on the INCOME phase edge beside the income/painter/boost floaters. VfxAuthoringPLAN VA-5 added seven CONTINUOUS rows - tile_selected, section_2x2, attack_range, move_target, wall_edge, upgrade_batch, tutorial_highlight. Unlike every row above them these are not one-shots: they are drawn every frame for as long as the tile is highlighted, so they dispatch through game/ui/widgets.py's submit_highlight rather than _play/PlayOnceVfx (whose despawn clock would respawn them each frame).
